task: Refine the App Theme to a Premium Material 3 Specification
instructions: 1. Modify 'lib/core/theme.dart' (or your main theme file). 2. Set ScaffoldBackground to #F8FAFC. This is crucial—it makes the white cards stand out. 3. Update the 'Stok Habis' (Out of Stock) UI: - Remove the solid red button/badge. - Replace it with a Container: decoration(color: #FEE2E2, borderRadius: 12), child: Text("Stok Habis", style: color: #991B1B). 4. Update the BottomNavigationBar: - Set background to Colors.white. - Set unselectedItemColor to Colors.grey[400]. - Set selectedItemColor to #4F46E5. 5. Refactor the 'Total Price' text in the Cart Summary to be Indigo (#4F46E5) and use a FontWeight.black (900) for maximum visual hierarchy. 6. Remove heavy shadows from all Cards; use a thin BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.withOpacity(0.2), width: 0.5) instead.
